project.name: rhuanssauro-WeatherMeter
project.description: A personal page that loads weather and sea state for one latitude and longitude, covering 15 days before today through the next 14 days, and can save that window as CSV or PDF. Condition flags are not a link budget and not a navigation aid.

tour.title: What the page does
tour.description: The README states the contract. One latitude and longitude. Fifteen days before today and today through the next fourteen days. CSV or PDF after a load. Flags are not a link budget and not a navigation aid. Nothing is fetched until Load 30 days.

tour.title: Page shell
tour.description: index.html is the dashboard. serve.py hosts it with the Python standard library. requirements.txt says there is no pip install.

tour.title: The 30-day window
tour.description: window.ts builds the date range. openmeteo.ts calls the forecast, archive, and marine hosts. aggregate.ts joins the series and leaves a missing value missing.

tour.title: Flags and export
tour.description: satcom.ts sets rain, cloud, gust, thunderstorm, and offshore sea-state flags. csv.ts writes the loaded window. The controller in app.ts starts the load.

tour.title: Emitted JavaScript
tour.description: The page runs the files under js/. They are the TypeScript emit. app.js is the runtime twin of app.ts. Read src/ when the two disagree.
tour.languageLesson: TypeScript here is the source. The browser loads the JavaScript emit. A change in src/ is not live until it is emitted to js/.

tour.title: Tests
tour.description: node:test covers aggregation, export, and the satcom flags. package.json is the script entry. TypeScript is the only dev dependency.
